question: Where is the nearest attraction situated on the way toward Quality Inn Chillicothe, Chillicothe, OH from Denison Biological Reserve / Polly Anderson Field Station, Granville, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Denison Biological Reserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Granville%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Quality Inn Chillicothe%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chillicothe%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), total_path_distance AS ( SELECT ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) AS dist FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, end_point ep, path_line pl, total_path_distance tpd WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' -- Ensure the attraction is within a 5km buffer of the straight-line path AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, pl.geom::geography, 5000) -- Ensure the attraction is "on the way" by being closer to the start point than the total path length AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) < tpd.dist ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
